description: Trigger evals for delivery-asset: it fires when finished task work must be written up for a non-engineering audience such as executives, customers, or partners in a chosen format, while team-update, pr-package, release-plan, postmortem-author and task-init handle a quick team note, reviewer-facing PR text, a rollout strategy, an incident record, and a new task.

should_trigger: the new export feature is done, I need something to send to our customers about it
Leadership is asking what came out of the search migration. Can you turn the task into a one-page readout for the execs, no jargon, and lead with what we shipped?
Write a release note for the customer-facing side of the billing change. Keep it to what is actually recorded in the task, please, no made-up numbers.
I have a demo for the all-hands on Friday. Put together a demo script with stage directions for the onboarding flow we just finished.
draft a short email to our partners saying the API change shipped, formal tone, under 200 words

should_not_trigger.prompt: Post a quick note in our engineering channel saying the retry work is done and I am waiting on review.
The diff is stable now. Give me the PR title, body, and reviewer attention points against main.
We are about to deploy the queue change. How should we roll it out, with a canary and a rollback trigger?
The outage last Tuesday is resolved. Write up a blameless timeline with contributing causes and action items.
I want to start work on adding audit logging to the admin panel. Set up the task folder for it.
